question: A company's LLM chatbot gives generic responses to cybersecurity questions. They have 10,000 high-quality cybersecurity Q&A pairs. What should they do?
options: A) Just use better prompts — prompt engineering is always enough
B) Use RAG to retrieve cybersecurity documents at query time
C) Fine-tune the LLM with the cybersecurity Q&A data using LoRA — the task is complex and requires specialist behavior
D) Replace the LLM with a rule-based system
explanation:
Why C: 关键条件：需要像专家一样回答领域问题 + 有高质量领域数据。

决策树：
• 简单任务 → Prompt Engineering（不需要微调）
• 数据变化快 → RAG（实时检索）
• 复杂任务 + 有数据 → Fine-tuning ✓
• 低质量数据 → 先清洗，不微调（GIGO）

B 不够好：RAG 只检索文档，不改变模型行为。微调让模型真正「学会」领域知识。

question: After fine-tuning an LLM on legal documents, the model becomes a great legal assistant but can no longer properly translate languages or write code. What happened?
options: A) The training data was corrupted
B) Catastrophic Forgetting — full fine-tuning caused the model to forget general capabilities while learning legal knowledge
C) The model is too small
D) The learning rate was too low
explanation:
Why B: Catastrophic Forgetting（灾难性遗忘） = 微调学了新领域知识后，忘记了原有通用知识。

Full Fine-Tuning vs LoRA：
• Full FT — 更新所有参数 → 可能灾难性遗忘
• LoRA — 冻结原始权重 + 训练小适配器 → 不会遗忘（原始权重没变）

这就是为什么 LoRA 比 Full FT 更安全——原始通用能力完整保留。

question: In LoRA, which components are frozen and which are trainable?
options: A) W_orig is Trainable (Billions params); A and B are Frozen
B) All parameters (W_orig, A, B) are Trainable
C) W_orig is Frozen (Billions params); A (d x r) and B (r x d) are Trainable (Millions params, < 1%)
D) Only B is Trainable; W_orig and A are Frozen
explanation:
Why C: LoRA 核心公式：W_new = W_orig + A × B

• W_orig（原始权重）— d×d — Frozen（Billions 参数一个不动）
• A（下投影）— d×r — Trainable
• B（上投影）— r×d — Trainable

LoRA 参数 = 2×d×r = 2×4096×16 = 131,072（仅 0.78%）

⚠️ A 选项是最常见的考试陷阱——W_orig 和 A/B 的状态反过来了！

question: If the training data quality is poor (noisy labels, factual errors), fine-tuning will still provide some improvement over the base model.
explanation:
Why False: Garbage In → Garbage Out (GIGO)

低质量数据微调可能比不微调更差——模型会学到错误模式！

微调前必须检查：
• 标注质量是否足够
• 数据是否有噪音
• 样本是否有偏差

如果数据不行 → 先清洗数据，不要急着微调。

question: A solo developer with a single RTX 4090 GPU wants to fine-tune Llama-3-8B. Which framework is most suitable?
options: A) Axolotl — designed for large-scale multi-GPU reproducible training
B) Unsloth — optimized for extreme speed and low VRAM on single consumer GPUs
C) HF PEFT — flexible Python API for deep integration
D) Training from scratch with PyTorch
explanation:
Why B: 关键条件：单卡消费级 GPU + 个人开发者。

四大微调框架选型：
• Unsloth ✓ — 极致速度/低显存，单卡消费级，上手难度低~中
• Axolotl — 可复现性/大规模，多卡 H100/A100
• LLaMA-Factory — Web UI 易用一体化
• HF PEFT — 灵活 Python API，适合深度集成

单张 RTX 4090 → Unsloth 最合适。

question: A company has real-time stock price data that changes every minute. They want the LLM to answer questions about current prices. Should they fine-tune the LLM?
options: A) Yes — fine-tune with the latest price data daily
B) No — use RAG to retrieve current prices at query time, because data changes too fast for fine-tuning to keep up
C) Yes — use LoRA adapters updated hourly
D) No — use prompt engineering to ask about prices
explanation:
Why B: 关键条件：数据变化极快（每分钟）。

微调的模型是一个快照——训完就开始过时。股票价格每分钟变 → 微调模型下一分钟就失效。

决策规则：
• 数据变化快 → RAG（实时检索最新数据）
• 数据相对稳定 + 需要专家行为 → Fine-tuning

A/C: 即使每天/每小时重新微调也跟不上每分钟的变化，且成本极高。

question: With LoRA, you need to store a complete copy of the model for each domain task (e.g., one full model for medical, one for legal, one for code).
explanation:
Why False: LoRA 的多任务优势 = 同一个 Base LLM + 不同 Adapter。

• 医疗 LoRA Adapter（几 MB）
• 法律 LoRA Adapter（几 MB）
• 代码 LoRA Adapter（几 MB）
• 共享同一个 Base LLM（几十 GB）

Full Fine-Tuning：每个任务一份完整模型 = N × 几十 GB
LoRA：1 个 Base + N 个小 Adapter = 几十 GB + N × 几 MB

这就是 LoRA 实现「训练民主化」的原因——存储和切换成本极低。

question: When should you NOT fine-tune an LLM? (Select the scenario where fine-tuning is the wrong approach)
options: A) You need the model to write code like a senior developer
B) You have 50,000 high-quality domain-specific Q&A pairs
C) You have sensitive patient medical records that cannot be used for training due to privacy regulations
D) You need the model to follow a specific output format consistently
explanation:
Why C: 隐私限制 = 不能微调！敏感数据不能用于训练。

替代方案：RAG + 本地部署（数据不离开本地，LLM 只在推理时读取）。

不该微调的四种情况：
① 简单任务 → Prompt Engineering
② 数据变化快 → RAG
③ 隐私限制 ✓ → RAG + 本地部署
④ 低质量数据 → 先清洗

A/B/D: 都是适合微调的场景。
